profile.headline: Software Consultant
profile.summary: I thrive on continuous learning and I am driven by the challenges. With every role I take, I bring a blend of technical expertise, creativity, and a vision for beautiful, frontend-focused innovation.

positions.title: Software Consultant
positions.description:
- Developed modern frontend solutions for clients, including McKesson, Bankers Financial, Archer, Lennar, and Cain Watters, using React, Angular, and Figma to deliver scalable, high-performance user interfaces.
- Translated Figma designs into fully functional, responsive UI components with complex business logic.
- Built prototypes to explore design concepts and enhance usability through iterative testing and client feedback.
- Implemented Continuous Delivery practices, incorporating real-time feedback from clients to accelerate iteration cycles and maintain product quality.
- Collaborated cross-functionally with designers, developers, and product managers in Scrum-Agile environments, participating in sprint planning, stand-ups, retrospectives, and bi-weekly client demos.
- Contributed to QA and research efforts, assisting in testing protocols, conducting interviews, and synthesizing findings into actionable documentation for design and product decisions.
- Authored comprehensive documentation and onboarding materials for Nearshore developers, helping new team members quickly understand project architecture, culture, and workflows—significantly reducing onboarding time.
- Created visual assets and internal documentation, including slide decks and meeting summaries, to track changes, communicate updates, and align teams effectively.
- Led knowledge organization initiatives within the People and Culture Navigators team—developing a strategic routing process and migrating Zeal’s internal resources to Google Sites for improved accessibility and structure. Reviewed and consolidated legacy materials, ensuring company guidelines, policies, and documentation remained accurate and up to date. Designed high-fidelity Figma components for internal and client use, establishing design consistency.
- Supported large-scale data migrations and information transfer efforts, ensuring accuracy and data integrity throughout transitions.

positions.title: Frontend Software Developer - McKesson
positions.description:
- Used agentic engineering for Angular with Cursor to efficiently deliver new UI enhancements and improve existing application features.
- Partnered with McKesson stakeholders to support decision-making around UI functionality, user flows, and screen behavior.
- Collaborated with backend developers to integrate new API endpoints into frontend services, supporting multiple, complete page-level workflows.
- Gained minimal hands-on experience with Java by learning the fundamentals of creating CRUD API endpoints with GitHub Copilot.
- Worked with QA to investigate issues, resolve bugs, and deliver timely fixes.
- Translated Figma designs into intuitive, consistent screens.

positions.title: People and Culture Navigator - Zeal (Internal)
positions.description:
I collaborated internally with Zeal’s leadership and recruiting teams to deliver a new Google-sites based internal knowledge network to deliver up to date information across the whole company.

· Initialized and assessed the pros and cons of creating a knowledge repository within Google Sites with Zeal’s leadership team and CEO.
· Crafted clean, strategic routing processes to organize internal company information.
· Reviewed hundreds of past recordings, guidelines, policies, and documentation to display accurate, up to date information across the entire company.
· Created high-fidelity designs and components in Figma for various pages.
· Designed screens and transferred internal knowledge from one site to another.

honors.title: 2020 Texas: Dallas/Fort Worth Rising Star Affiliate
honors.description:
"The NCWIT Award for Aspirations in Computing (AiC) honors 9th-12th grade women, genderqueer, or non-binary students for their computing-related achievements and interests, and encourages them to pursue their passions. Award recipients are selected based on their aptitude and aspirations in technology and computing, as demonstrated by their computing experience, computing-related activities, leadership experience, tenacity in the face of barriers to access, and future plans. Since 2007, more than 20,000 students have received an Award for AiC.

The multi-tiered award structure includes Winner, Honorable Mention, and Rising Star designations at National and Regional Affiliate levels, serving all 50 states, the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico, the U.S. Virgin Islands, Guam, all U.S. overseas military bases, and Canada. Regional Affiliate Award programs are hosted in 79 locations nationwide by NCWIT Alliance member organizations—a powerful, national network of universities, companies, non-profits, and government organizations working to increase the influence and meaningful participation of girls and women from every community.

The NCWIT Award for AiC is sponsored by Apple, Bank of America, Microsoft, and Motorola Solutions Foundation."
honors.issuer: Issued by NCWIT Aspirations in Computing · Feb 2020
